evidence.quote: Every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist

observations.why: Universal mandate framing ('every … completes') enacts authority-ranking: a uniform requirement imposed on all new hires without negotiation.

evidence.quote:
It replaced the
old wiki page last quarter.

observations.why: Stating that the checklist replaced a prior system reports a governance substitution — one authority structure superseding another — but the relational signal is thin and the act is reported rather than performed.
